title: Avtolmos, a Tanna of the Mishnah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Mishnah Eruvin 3:4 [supplied 2:4]: Rabbi Yose said that Avtolmos testified in the name of five elders. So too in Rosh Hashanah 15a [supplied 46a]. He was also R’ Yose’s teacher, as in Eruvin 36a.
And we find R' Yonatan ben Avtolmos in Sanhedrin 87b, and Shimon ben Avtolmos in Bava Batra 68a.

notes.text: The supplied Rosh Hashanah46a reference is impossible within that tractate’s standard pagination and remains unresolved. The Eruvin testimony, teacher relationship and later patronym list are preserved without guessing a replacement work.

The saved whole Davidson RoshHashanah15a scalar explicitly has Rabbi Yose reporting Avtolmos’s five-elders testimony about etrog tithing. It supplies a relevant second attestation beside supplied מו. (46a), rather than a newly selected work. This does not establish the same substantive ruling as Eruvin or prove mem/tet transcription history. The teacher relationship and Yonatan/Shimon patronymics remain Hyman’s reports, with no family merge. Other cited exact personal-title occurrences were not newly inspected.

Hyman’s printed notice gives Mishnah Eruvin 3:4 and Rosh Hashanah 15. The supplied transcription gives 2:4 and 46a. The consulted Mishnah 3:4 reports testimony about a doubtful eruv, while Rosh Hashanah 15a reports testimony about when an etrog is tithed. Eruvin 36a offers the distinction between Yose’s position and his teacher’s; Rashi there identifies the teacher as Avtolmos. Sanhedrin 87b and Bava Batra 68a name Yonatan and Shimon, respectively, with the patronymic ben Avtolmos.
